3.translation:
Sankey displays each source once in each column. Query endpoints connect from
the left to subject endpoints on the right. Reciprocal input rows stay distinct;
same-entity links are excluded by default (⟦shared:0⟧ opts in). Widths
come from both real intervals. This layout expresses relationships, not flow
conservation. It owns its left/right copies and does not accept ⟦shared:1⟧ or
shared branches in this first version.

11.translation: Each of two sources appears once on each side. Do not duplicate seq_data to manufacture observations. Reciprocal records stay distinct. self_links = TRUE enables existing self records without creating any. seq_order contains each source once; between and shared branches are unsupported.

12.translation: Example: trace both ends of one ribbon back to query and subject and explain why total widths need not be conserved.
